zipzi_contract::authoring::MeshCreateSpe.doc:
Specification for creating a mesh. An omitted ID allocates a fresh UUID when
creation executes; an empty texture_asset_id leaves the texture unassigned.

fields.doc: Human-readable display name; use the stable ID for identity because names can change.
fields.name: name

fields.doc:
Owned vertex IDs, positions, UVs and triangles; triangles contain vertex IDs, not
position offsets.
fields.name: geometry

fields.doc:
Image-asset ID used by this mesh; the default empty string leaves its texture
reference unassigned.

Optional new mesh UUID; None allocates a fresh UUID in the SDK when the create
operation executes.
fields.name: id

zipzi_contract::authoring::MeshGeometry.doc:
Vertex IDs, authoring-space positions, texture UVs and triangle connectivity for a mesh.
Positions and UVs follow vertex_ids order; triangles contain vertex IDs.
Positions use model space without a deformation parent, otherwise the parent's
local/parameter space.

fields.doc: Stable vertex IDs in the same order as positions and UVs; IDs need not be contiguous.
fields.name: vertex_ids

fields.doc:
Absolute XY coordinates in the mesh authoring space (model space without a deformation
parent, otherwise the parent's local/parameter space), ordered by vertex_ids.
fields.name: positions

fields.doc: Texture UV coordinates ordered by vertex_ids.
fields.name: uvs

fields.doc: Triangle entries reference vertex_ids values, never offsets into positions.
fields.name: triangles

fields.doc: Optional canonical UV boundary and retained internal structure edges.
fields.name: meshing

Change a mesh display name by stable ID. An expected_name precondition

runtime_id.
fields.name: id

Replace selected vertex positions, pairing vertex_ids and positions in
supplied order. Positions are absolute in the mesh authoring space,
not additive offsets.

Stable vertex IDs selecting which positions to replace; values are paired with

vertex_ids selection.

fields.doc: Complete replacement BlendShape bindings for the remeshed object.

removes it.

zipzi_contract::model::Mesh.doc: Authored drawable mesh with stable vertex identities, geometry and resource references.

fields.name: id

fields.doc: Human-readable display name; use the stable ID for identity because names can change.
